g.text: Title: Pearl V2 Assembly & Wiring — Connection Schedule

g.desc: Title: Pearl V2 Assembly & Wiring — Connection Schedule

g.text: Logical wiring aid; physical placement/orientation unestablished

g.desc: Logical wiring aid; physical placement/orientation unestablished

g.text: WindSonic J2.4 TXD+ → U2.R+; J2.5 TXD− → U2.R−.

g.desc: WindSonic J2.4 TXD+ → U2.R+; J2.5 TXD− → U2.R−.

g.text: WindSonic J2.1 signal ground → U2.RGND (separate from GND).

g.desc: WindSonic J2.1 signal ground → U2.RGND (separate from GND).

g.text: RF: Heltec LoRa IPEX → J3.1; J3.2 → AE1.1.

g.desc: RF: Heltec LoRa IPEX → J3.1; J3.2 → AE1.1.

g.text: U2.TXD USED; RXD UNUSED. TTL data is the module-to-Heltec connection, not RS-422.

g.desc: U2.TXD USED; RXD UNUSED. TTL data is the module-to-Heltec connection, not RS-422.

g.text: D1: pin 1 = A (battery side); pin 2 = K / band (protected supply).

g.desc: D1: pin 1 = A (battery side); pin 2 = K / band (protected supply).

g.text: D2: pin 1 = K / band (protected supply); pin 2 = A (GND).

g.desc: D2: pin 1 = K / band (protected supply); pin 2 = A (GND).

g.text: U1: pin 1 = input; pin 2 = GND; pin 3 = +5V output.

g.desc: U1: pin 1 = input; pin 2 = GND; pin 3 = +5V output.

g.text: U3.J2 / U3.J3 are HELTEC headers; schematic J2 is the SENSOR

g.desc: U3.J2 / U3.J3 are HELTEC headers; schematic J2 is the SENSOR

g.text: connector, and schematic J3 is the RF PIGTAIL. Do not confuse them.

g.desc: connector, and schematic J3 is the RF PIGTAIL. Do not confuse them.

g.text: 02 EXACT CONNECTION SCHEDULE | Every terminal on the same row connects together.

g.desc: 02 EXACT CONNECTION SCHEDULE | Every terminal on the same row connects together.

g.text: ASSEMBLY LIMITS — RESOLVE BEFORE USING AS A PHYSICAL PLACEMENT GUIDE

g.desc: ASSEMBLY LIMITS — RESOLVE BEFORE USING AS A PHYSICAL PLACEMENT GUIDE

g.text: No physical board layout, pad map, hole spacing, component locations or Heltec mounting orientation is established by the schematic.

g.desc: No physical board layout, pad map, hole spacing, component locations or Heltec mounting orientation is established by the schematic.

g.text: The Heltec box is a logical module view, NOT a top/bottom view or a header-position drawing. Connector mating/view direction is unspecified.

g.desc: The Heltec box is a logical module view, NOT a top/bottom view or a header-position drawing. Connector mating/view direction is unspecified.

g.text: Confirm those physical details against the actual board before soldering; this document deliberately assigns no new pads or jumpers.

g.desc: Confirm those physical details against the actual board before soldering; this document deliberately assigns no new pads or jumpers.

g.text: Connector part numbers, resistor tolerances/power ratings, capacitor voltage ratings, U2 termination setting and RF pigtail part number remain unresolved.

g.desc: Connector part numbers, resistor tolerances/power ratings, capacitor voltage ratings, U2 termination setting and RF pigtail part number remain unresolved.

g.text: Unused: WindSonic J2 pins 6–9; U2 T+, T− and RXD (UNUSED). Do not wire them. No additional power or ground connections are implied.

g.desc: Unused: WindSonic J2 pins 6–9; U2 T+, T− and RXD (UNUSED). Do not wire them. No additional power or ground connections are implied.

g.text: GPIO2 battery sensing is retained exactly as drawn. This assembly aid makes no hardware corrections or redesigns.

g.desc: GPIO2 battery sensing is retained exactly as drawn. This assembly aid makes no hardware corrections or redesigns.

g.text: Assembly aid only • electrical schematic remains authoritative • no PCB placement implied

g.desc: Assembly aid only • electrical schematic remains authoritative • no PCB placement implied
